description:
Introducing Hill Street House – Dublin's Newest Co-Living Community


Hill Street House offers a convenient, all-inclusive way to live in the heart of Dublin. Whether you're starting a new career, pursuing your studies, relocating to the city or simply looking for a flexible, community-focused home, everything you need is under one roof.

All-Inclusive Living
One simple monthly payment includes:
•	Heating & Electricity
•	High-Speed WiFi
•	Water & Refuse Collection
•	Fully Equipped Gym
•	Rooftop Terrace in the Heart of the City
•	Flexible Co-Working Spaces
•	Resident Events

Premium Resident Amenities
Enjoy an exceptional range of shared spaces designed for work, wellbeing and socialising, including:
•	Cinema
•	Resident Lounges
•	Chef-Inspired Communal Kitchens
•	Wellness & Yoga Studio
•	On-Site Café
•	24-Hour Concierge & Building Security
•	Secure Bicycle Storage

Your Private Studio
Every studio apartment is fully furnished and includes:
•	Private Ensuite Bathroom
•	Modern Kitchenette
•	Dedicated Workspace
•	Smart Storage

City Centre Living
Located on Hill Street, you'll be within walking distance of Dublin's leading employers, universities, cafés, restaurants, shops and excellent public transport connections.
Register your interest today and be among the first to experience Hill Street House when it opens this September.































Hill Street Capital Limited in its capacity as general partner of Hill Street Limited Partnership (the “Owner”) intends to sell the property upon completion, and the purchasing entity will be the grantor of licences to occupy the building. If you wish to reserve a unit, you can enter into an Agreement For Licence with the Owner and the Licence will be granted by the purchasing entity following its acquisition of the property
